_variant_note: Wave-5 filter-trap: customer asks to 'show me my dispute requests — I raised one about a failed ATM transaction.' The only request with category=charges_dispute is a fee complaint from January (resolved). The actual ATM withdrawal failure was raised as a service_quality request (REQ-SQ-96102, in_progress). A category filter for 'charges_dispute' or 'dispute'-type categories hides the real request. Broad query or no category filter reveals the service_quality request.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks to see their 'dispute requests' about a failed ATM transaction. The charges_dispute request (REQ-CH-96101) is an old resolved fee complaint — not the ATM issue. The ATM withdrawal failure was actually raised as a service_quality request (REQ-SQ-96102, in_progress since Aug 25). The assistant must query all requests and surface the ATM failure request, correcting the customer's assumption about which category it's under. Showing only the charges_dispute and saying no ATM request exists fails.
